reached_sql:
WITH sales_by_brand_month AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        dt.d_year,
        dt.d_moy,
        item.i_brand_id,
        item.i_brand,
        sum(store_sales.ss_sales_price) AS sum_agg
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN item
        ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim dt
        ON dt.d_date_sk = store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk
    WHERE item.i_manufact_id = 816
      AND dt.d_moy = 11
    GROUP BY
        dt.d_year,
        dt.d_moy,
        item.i_brand_id,
        item.i_brand
)
SELECT
    d_year,
    i_brand_id AS brand_id,
    i_brand AS brand,
    sum_agg
FROM sales_by_brand_month
ORDER BY
    d_year,
    sum_agg DESC,
    brand_id
LIMIT 100
